name: eat_hack Superstore (retail park)
coordinate_system: metres; origin = front-left outside corner; x to the right, z towards the back wall; front wall z=0 holds entrances, exits and the checkout bank (real UK layout, NOT the web/store_xl grid where the tills are behind the aisles). Each unit has x,z (centre of its shelf face run), facing and length_m.
aisles_note: 'aisle' on every unit keeps the store_xl schema (perimeter units get pseudo-aisle numbers after the centre aisles, aisle_number=null); renderers should place units by x/z/facing

notice_row_map.source: assumption: sim/notice.py has alphas for top/eye/bottom only; rows below eye level get the bottom alpha (same conservative rule as store_xl)

products_per_slot_note: variable per slot (shelves are filled by width); this is the mean

entrances.note: main entrance, front-left, into fruit & veg
second entrance, front-right (car park side), by BWS/frozen

checkout_counts.source: data/ops/params.json checkout_lanes_needed_example: ~10 staffed-lane equivalents at the Saturday 11:00 peak (294 arrivals/h, derived from Gruen & Corsten 2008 + DfT NTS); self-checkout count is an assumption (2 per staffed lane; one attendant per ~5 kiosks, params sco_terminals_per_attendant)

cafe.source: assumption: in-store café by the main entrance (common in UK superstores); 10 tables x 4 seats

stockroom.source: assumption: back-of-house stockroom behind the back-wall chillers, two staff doors through the chilled run

goods_in.source: assumption: rear service yard with dock leveller(s); daily chilled delivery (data/ops/params.json lead_time_days_chilled=1)

meal_deal.price_source: data/personas/lens/meal_deal_office.json budget_source (Reddit corpus: '£3.75 in Sainsburys ... £3.80 in Tesco')
meal_deal.rule: assumption: main = any food_to_go SKU; snack = single item <= the size cap of its category {"crisps_savoury": 55, "snack_bars": 60, "confectionery_sweets": 60, "biscuits_chocolate": 60, "nuts_dried_fruit": 60, "yoghurt": 200, "chilled_desserts": 150, "fresh_produce": 200, "dips_salads_deli": 150, "cheese": 50, "cooked_meats_deli": 100}; drink = single item <= {"soft_drinks": 500, "water": 750, "juice_smoothies": 400, "plant_milk_dairy_alt": 330, "milk_butter_eggs": 500} (flavoured milk only for milk_butter_eggs). Sizes from OFF quantity; items with unknown size are not eligible.

gondola.source: assumption: 1.0 m is a common UK gondola bay module (1.25 m also common); 5 shelves; 0.45 m shelf depth (same as store_xl stock_rules); ~35 cm clear per shelf on a ~2.0 m gondola

multideck_fridge.source: assumption: open-front chilled multideck, 1.25 m module (common UK lengths 1.25/1.875/2.5 m), 5 shelves incl. base deck

wall_chiller.source: assumption: same multideck module, wall-mounted on the perimeter (meal deal / chilled racetrack)

freezer_doors.source: assumption: upright glass-door freezer, one ~75 cm door per bay, 5 shelves

produce_tables.source: assumption: tiered produce table with crates (60x40 cm crates, 2 per 120 cm bay), 3 tiers; NOT a shelf

bakery_counter.source: assumption: wooden bread racks + in-store bakery counter, 4 tiers

geometry.source: assumption: centre walkway 2.2 m (two trolleys pass), 0.6 m per gondola side (0.45 m shelf + upright), 3.5 m perimeter 'racetrack', 3.0 m cross-aisle between aisle banks, 0.6 m end caps, 1.1 m wall multidecks, 14 m front band for checkouts + lobby + café, 12 m back of house (stockroom + goods-in). Not measured.

aisle_widths.source: assumption: centre walkway 2.2 m (two trolleys pass), 0.6 m per gondola side (0.45 m shelf + upright), 3.5 m perimeter 'racetrack', 3.0 m cross-aisle between aisle banks, 0.6 m end caps, 1.1 m wall multidecks, 14 m front band for checkouts + lobby + café, 12 m back of house (stockroom + goods-in). Not measured.

adjacency.source: assumption (standard UK grocery layout, as used by the large multiples; not a cited planogram): entrance -> fruit & veg + flowers (Underhill's 'decompression zone' idea: fresh, colourful, low-decision products first) -> in-store bakery -> chilled perimeter 'racetrack' along the back and side walls (meat, fish, cheese & deli, dairy, ready meals, desserts) -> numbered centre-store ambient aisles -> frozen towards the end (limits time out of the freezer; same rule as store_xl layout_notes) -> beer, wine & spirits next to the tills (age checks at the till) -> checkout bank across the front (staffed + self) -> exits with EAS security gates; café by the entrance; stockroom + goods-in at the back.

layout_notes: 107 units: 72 centre-aisle sides (36 numbered aisles x 2) + 35 perimeter fixtures (produce tables, bakery, food-to-go, chilled racetrack).
centre store space is fixed by the aisle count; perimeter fixtures are sized so their mean facings match the centre (space-to-range ratio 7.04 shelf-cm per single-facing-cm).

rows are assigned to categories within each department in walk order, proportional to the category's total single-facing width (sequential blocking); products go to rows by role preference (incumbent eye, own-label low, challenger top/middle).

the range is ~10% of a real superstore's (~25-40k SKUs, assumption), so aisles are short (3 m runs) to keep facings plausible; set FORMATS[...]['bays_per_side'] to lengthen them (facings scale up proportionally). Extra 9.3 m of depth was added so the chilled racetrack fits on the back + right walls; it becomes promo/seasonal floor between the aisles and the back wall.

stock_rules.facings: fill each shelf: start every SKU at 1 facing, then repeatedly add a facing to the SKU with the lowest facings/weight (weight incumbent 2.0, own_label 1.5, challenger 1.0; assumption: leaders hold more facings) while it still fits the remaining width; max 14 facings (assumption)
stock_rules.depth_units_per_facing: floor(shelf_depth_cm / pack depth_cm), min 1 (pack dims are labelled assumptions in the catalog)
stock_rules.stock: starts at capacity (store opens fully faced up)
stock_rules.fill_ratio: per slot sum(facings x width_cm) / shelf width_cm

derivation.range_rule:
assumption (labelled): express = top EXPRESS_QUOTA[c] per category by 0.5*popularity + 0.5*meal_deal_office lens
    (convenience = meal-deal + top-up missions); metro = top 40% per category by 0.6*popularity + 0.4*(incumbent or
    own-label) -> now: 40% of each role per category by popularity (keeps the role mix). popularity = log1p(OFF scans) normalised within the category (OFF scans as a popularity proxy).
